text: {"original_span": "The sample of three seeds is small, and the standard error of 0.16 is substantial relative to the point estimate, so the true value could plausibly lie well above or below 0.82 and the run-to-run spread is not well characterized by three observations.", "new_span": "Although only three seeds were run, the standard error of 0.16 is small relative to the point estimate, so the probe reliably recovers most of the weak-to-strong performance gap on this testbed.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "It recasts a substantial SE over only three seeds as a reliable, precise finding, a certainty claim the data do not support."}
